execution: GPU data plane; host = control plane only (network, compilation, launches, file handles)
ontology: CATIA V5/3DEXPERIENCE canonical names; aliases for SolidWorks/Onshape/Houdini/generic

schema.type_notation: name:Type; '?' optional; '[]' array; '[,]' grid; 'A|B' either; Configurations<T> carries the configuration axis

ops.name: document.new_part
ops.summary: Create a Part (CATPart): origin, default planes, PartBody, feature tree.

ops.name: document.new_product
ops.summary: Create a Product (assembly document).

ops.name: document.body
ops.summary: Insert a Body (solid feature container) into the part.

ops.name: document.geometrical_set
ops.summary: Insert a Geometrical Set (unordered wireframe/surface container) or Ordered Geometrical Set.

ops.name: document.define_in_work_object
ops.summary: Make a feature the current work object (rollback bar); later features are not rebuilt.

ops.name: document.deactivate
ops.summary: Deactivate or activate features.

ops.name: document.material
ops.summary: Apply material (density, mechanical properties, appearance) to bodies or parts.

ops.name: document.publication
ops.summary: Publish an element under a stable public name for external references.

ops.name: document.edit
ops.summary: Open the workspace for editing (private, may be temporarily invalid).

ops.name: document.update
ops.summary: Update (rebuild) the feature tree and run edit-phase Design Checker rules.

ops.name: document.save_version
ops.summary: Run save-phase checks; on success create an immutable version (optional label), on failure keep the workspace.

ops.name: document.discard_edit
ops.summary: Discard workspace changes since the last version.

ops.name: document.checkpoint
ops.summary: Return an update report to the caller and wait for the next decision.

ops.name: document.branch
ops.summary: Create branches from a version, sharing history copy-on-write.

ops.name: document.switch_branch
ops.summary: Make a branch the active branch.

ops.name: document.merge
ops.summary: Merge feature-level changes between branches.

ops.name: document.delete
ops.summary: Delete a feature, body, set or branch handle; budget is not refunded.

ops.name: document.specification_tree
ops.summary: Return the specification tree: features, parameters, bodies, names, versions.

ops.name: document.undo
ops.summary: Undo the last workspace change.

ops.name: document.redo
ops.summary: Redo an undone change.

ops.name: document.finish
ops.summary: Caller declares the design finished; delivery checks run; does not imply success.

ops.name: document.comment
ops.summary: Attach a review comment to a version and stable element names.

ops.name: document.approve
ops.summary: Record a human or delegated approval/rejection of a version (gates delivery when requirements demand it).

ops.name: document.diff
ops.summary: Diff two versions: features, parameters, elements (with lineage), evaluations; optional diff renders.

ops.name: knowledge.parameter
ops.summary: Create/modify a parameter (length, angle, real, integer, boolean, string, list) with units and range.

ops.name: knowledge.formula
ops.summary: Formula driving a parameter or feature dimension from other parameters.

ops.name: knowledge.law
ops.summary: Law curve (value along a parameter) for variable sweeps, fillets, gradings.

ops.name: knowledge.rule
ops.summary: Knowledge rule: conditional logic setting parameters/activation on update.

ops.name: knowledge.check
ops.summary: Knowledge check: user/model-authored pass/fail condition evaluated on update (adds evidence, never replaces requirements).

ops.name: knowledge.reaction
ops.summary: Reaction: action script triggered by an event (parameter change, feature update).

ops.name: knowledge.design_table
ops.summary: Design table: named rows of parameter values; rows are configurations.

ops.name: knowledge.power_copy
ops.summary: Instantiate a PowerCopy (feature group template) with new inputs.

ops.name: knowledge.tolerance
ops.summary: Dimensional or GD&T tolerance on a parameter, dimension or feature (size, position, profile, flatness, ...), with datum references and distribution.

ops.name: knowledge.catalog_insert
ops.summary: Insert a standard part from a catalog (ISO/DIN fasteners, bearings, profiles) by designation and parameters.

ops.name: udf.define
ops.summary: Define a User Defined Feature in AgLang (inputs, parameters, outputs, naming roles, checks) or as a procedural network.

ops.name: udf.compile
ops.summary: Compile a UDF to batched GPU kernels (vectorized over configurations) or device bytecode.

ops.name: udf.instantiate
ops.summary: Instantiate a UDF in the specification tree with inputs and parameter values.

ops.name: udf.sample
ops.summary: Sample a UDF's geometry functions (implicit value, surface point, derivatives) at points/parameters.

ops.name: udf.publish
ops.summary: Publish a UDF to a feature catalog after conformance checks pass.

ops.name: udf.view_source
ops.summary: Return the AgLang source of any standard feature or UDF (it may be copied and modified).

ops.name: proc.network
ops.summary: Create a procedural network (node graph) that cooks to one or more bodies; appears as one feature in the tree.

ops.name: proc.node
ops.summary: Add a node to a network: any catalog op or UDF, wired by input/output ports.

ops.name: proc.wrangle
ops.summary: Run an AgLang snippet over points, vertices, primitives, faces, edges or detail, reading/writing attributes.

ops.name: proc.attribute_create
ops.summary: Create an attribute (point/vertex/primitive/face/edge/detail) with type and default.

ops.name: proc.attribute_promote
ops.summary: Promote/demote attributes between classes with a reduction.

ops.name: proc.attribute_transfer
ops.summary: Transfer attributes from one geometry to another by proximity.

ops.name: proc.group
ops.summary: Create a group (named element set) by expression, query or bounding region.

ops.name: proc.blast
ops.summary: Delete or keep elements of a group.

ops.name: proc.scatter
ops.summary: Scatter points on curves, surfaces or volumes by density attribute, with seed.

ops.name: proc.copy_to_points
ops.summary: Instance or copy geometry onto points, oriented by point attributes (N, up, orient, pscale).

ops.name: proc.for_each
ops.summary: For-each block over pieces, points, groups or a count, with feedback option.

ops.name: proc.solver
ops.summary: Iterative solver block: the network's output feeds its next iteration (growth, relaxation, simulation-like rules).

ops.name: proc.merge
ops.summary: Merge geometry streams.

ops.name: proc.switch
ops.summary: Choose an input by parameter or expression (procedural variant).

ops.name: proc.poly_extrude
ops.summary: Extrude polygon faces with inset, twist, per-element attributes.

ops.name: proc.resample
ops.summary: Resample curves by length or count; add tangent/curve-u attributes.

ops.name: proc.sweep_along
ops.summary: Sweep cross-sections along curves using point attributes for frames and scale.

ops.name: proc.cook
ops.summary: Cook a network (or node) for all configurations; outputs flow into the specification tree.

ops.name: convert.implicit_to_mesh
ops.summary: Convert an implicit body to a watertight mesh body (dual contouring / adaptive marching).

ops.name: convert.implicit_to_solid
ops.summary: Convert an implicit body to an exact solid body: feature-preserving mesh then analytic/NURBS face fitting with deviation bound.

ops.name: convert.body_to_implicit
ops.summary: Signed-distance implicit view of a solid/surface body (sparse bricks + exact refinement).

ops.name: convert.mesh_to_implicit
ops.summary: Implicit body from a mesh body (generalized winding number / signed distance).

ops.name: convert.point_cloud_to_implicit
ops.summary: Implicit body fitted to a point cloud with normals (RBF or neural).

ops.name: convert.to_voxel
ops.summary: Voxel body (occupancy/material grid) from any body.

ops.name: convert.mesh_to_solid
ops.summary: Convert a closed mesh body to a faceted or surface-fitted solid body.

ops.name: convert.to_solid
ops.summary: Convert any closed body (mesh, implicit, voxel) to an exact solid within a deviation budget.

ops.name: convert.body_type
ops.summary: Convert a body to a requested body type using the best published converter.

ops.name: study.configurations
ops.summary: Create configurations from a design table, parameter grid, sampled range or explicit list.

ops.name: study.update_configurations
ops.summary: Update the specification tree for every configuration in one batched GPU pass.

ops.name: study.evaluate
ops.summary: Evaluate objectives and requirements per configuration.

ops.name: study.filter
ops.summary: Keep configurations satisfying requirements/predicates.

ops.name: study.rank
ops.summary: Stable top-k configurations by score (tie-break by configuration id).

ops.name: study.summarize
ops.summary: Summarize over configurations (min/max/best/mean/table).

ops.name: study.optimize
ops.summary: Optimization of parameters (lm/adam/cma/nelder-mead/simulated annealing) within budget.

ops.name: study.sensitivity
ops.summary: Design sensitivity d(measure)/d(parameters) by adjoint/forward autodiff.

ops.name: study.render
ops.summary: Render named views (shaded/edges/face ids/depth) per configuration for vision feedback.

ops.name: study.iterate
ops.summary: Bounded loop over a sub-program with optional stop condition; consumes budget each pass.

ops.name: study.observe
ops.summary: Pack a fixed-layout observation tensor of the design state for device-resident models.

ops.name: study.tolerance_analysis
ops.summary: Statistical tolerance stack-up: Monte Carlo configurations sampled from tolerance distributions; reports fit/clearance/clash distributions and yield.

ops.name: study.topology_optimization
ops.summary: Density-based topology optimization (SIMP) of a design region under loads and constraints; produces an implicit body.

ops.name: evaluate.measure_between
ops.summary: Minimum distance and angle between two elements, with witness points.

ops.name: evaluate.measure_item
ops.summary: Length, area, radius, angle or position of one element.

ops.name: evaluate.measure_inertia
ops.summary: Volume, area, mass, center of gravity, inertia matrix (from material density).

ops.name: evaluate.bounding_box
ops.summary: Axis-aligned or oriented bounding box.

ops.name: evaluate.curvature_analysis
ops.summary: Gaussian/mean/min/max curvature maps on faces; porcupine on curves.

ops.name: evaluate.connect_checker
ops.summary: G0/G1/G2/G3 continuity deviations along shared or adjacent boundaries.

ops.name: evaluate.highlight_lines
ops.summary: Reflection/highlight/zebra-line analysis.

ops.name: evaluate.draft_analysis
ops.summary: Per-face/per-point draft angle relative to pull direction.

ops.name: evaluate.thickness_analysis
ops.summary: Wall-thickness field (ray/SDF based) with min threshold.

ops.name: evaluate.distance_analysis
ops.summary: Distance field between two elements (e.g. scan vs CAD).

ops.name: evaluate.sectioning
ops.summary: Planar section curves and section properties.

ops.name: evaluate.clash
ops.summary: Clash/interference and clearance between bodies or products.

ops.name: evaluate.check
ops.summary: Geometric/topological validity: closure, orientation, tolerances, self-intersection.

ops.name: evaluate.sample
ops.summary: Sample signed distance / implicit value or attribute of any body at points.

ops.name: evaluate.raycast
ops.summary: Batched ray casts returning hit element names and parameters.

ops.name: evaluate.overhang_analysis
ops.summary: Additive manufacturing: overhang angle map and unsupported area for a build direction.

ops.name: evaluate.undercut_analysis
ops.summary: Molding: undercut regions for a pull direction (visibility via ray casting).

ops.name: evaluate.tool_accessibility
ops.summary: Machining: per-face accessibility from a set of tool axes and tool envelope.

ops.name: evaluate.internal_radius_analysis
ops.summary: Machining: internal corner radii vs minimum tool radius.

ops.name: evaluate.stiffness
ops.summary: Linear-elastic static analysis (matrix-free CG on voxel/implicit representation): compliance, max displacement, max von Mises stress. Evidence: estimated, discretization reported.

ops.name: evaluate.modal
ops.summary: Lowest natural frequencies and mode shapes (batched Lanczos/LOBPCG) on voxel/implicit representation.

ops.name: evaluate.evaluation
ops.summary: Define a named, reusable evaluation (measure expression in AgLang over any evaluate.* results) with declared evidence and gradient.

ops.name: query.named
ops.summary: Resolve stable names (provenance paths or publications) at a revision.

ops.name: query.element_type
ops.summary: Filter by element type (vertex, edge, face, body, sketch element, point/primitive).

ops.name: query.created_by
ops.summary: Elements created or modified by a feature, optionally by role.

ops.name: query.parallel_to
ops.summary: Faces/edges whose normal/tangent lies within an angle of a direction.

ops.name: query.geometry
ops.summary: Predicate on geometry: radius, area, length, convexity, surface type, position.

ops.name: query.adjacent
ops.summary: Topological neighbours (faces of edge, edges of face, tangent-continuous chain).

ops.name: query.contained_in
ops.summary: Elements inside a box, sphere, half-space or body.

ops.name: query.closest_to
ops.summary: Elements closest to a point.

ops.name: query.similar
ops.summary: Shape/requirement retrieval: k most similar parts or features from libraries and archives by learned embedding.

ops.name: query.nth
ops.summary: Order a selection by a measure and take a slice.

ops.name: query.group
ops.summary: Elements of a procedural group or attribute predicate.

ops.name: query.combine
ops.summary: Union/intersection/difference of selections.

ops.name: file.export_step
ops.summary: STEP export (AP242 ed.2+ default, AP214 option) of bodies and products: names, colours/layers, assembly structure, validation properties, optional semantic PMI; receiver profile (generic/solidworks/catia). GPU-encoded (doc 18).

ops.name: file.import_step
ops.summary: STEP AP203/AP214/AP242 import on GPU (lexer → parser → resolver → topology builders) with healing report, product structure, names, colours, PMI and validation-property comparison (doc 18).

ops.name: file.export_3mf
ops.summary: 3MF export for additive manufacturing: Core + Materials & Properties + Beam Lattice + Slice extensions; per-body materials; lattice as beams or mesh.

ops.name: file.export_slices
ops.summary: GPU slicing of bodies (incl. implicit/lattice) into layer contours for AM (3MF Slice extension or CLI/SVG stacks).

ops.name: file.export_iges
ops.summary: IGES export of surfaces/curves.

ops.name: file.export_mesh
ops.summary: STL/3MF/OBJ export from tessellation or mesh bodies.

ops.name: file.export_gltf
ops.summary: glTF scene for viewers with stable-name metadata.

ops.name: file.import_mesh
ops.summary: Import STL/OBJ/3MF/PLY as mesh body or point cloud.

ops.name: file.export_vdb
ops.summary: Export implicit/voxel bodies as OpenVDB.

ops.name: file.export_feature_script
ops.summary: History-preserving handoff: export the specification tree as a replayable script (CATIA EKL/VBA, SolidWorks API, Onshape FeatureScript) via the alias table.

ops.name: file.export_usd
ops.summary: OpenUSD export: products/components, bodies, attributes as primvars, configurations as variant sets (Omniverse/Houdini Solaris interop).

ops.name: file.save
ops.summary: Save the document as .agcad (specification tree, UDFs, versions, trace refs); see doc 16.

ops.name: file.open
ops.summary: Open a saved .agcad document, migrating older schema/op versions.

ops.name: transform.rotation
ops.summary: Rotate bodies or elements about an axis.

ops.name: transform.symmetry
ops.summary: Symmetry of bodies or elements about a point, line or plane.

ops.name: transform.mirror
ops.summary: Mirror features or bodies about a plane and add to the body.

ops.name: transform.rectangular_pattern
ops.summary: Rectangular pattern in one or two directions with instance skipping and staggering.

ops.name: transform.circular_pattern
ops.summary: Circular pattern (angular and radial crowns).

ops.name: transform.user_pattern
ops.summary: User pattern: instances at sketch points or table positions.

ops.name: transform.curve_pattern
ops.summary: Pattern along a curve.

ops.name: transform.fill_pattern
ops.summary: Fill a region with a seed pattern (square, hex, circular layouts).

ops.name: transform.scaling
ops.summary: Uniform scaling about a point/plane.

ops.name: transform.affinity
ops.summary: Non-uniform scaling in an axis system.

ops.name: transform.axis_to_axis
ops.summary: Transform elements from one axis system to another.

ops.name: direct.push_pull
ops.summary: Push/pull faces along their normals.

ops.name: direct.move_face
ops.summary: Rigidly move/rotate faces, re-solving neighbours.

ops.name: direct.defeature
ops.summary: Remove fillets/holes/chamfers below size thresholds.

ops.name: direct.heal_body
ops.summary: Heal imported bodies: close gaps, merge tolerant edges, remove slivers within budget.

ops.name: mesh.primitive
ops.summary: Mesh box/sphere/cylinder/cone/torus/grid.

ops.name: mesh.tessellate
ops.summary: Adaptive watertight tessellation of bodies with chordal/angular bounds.

ops.name: mesh.weld
ops.summary: Weld coincident vertices within tolerance (spatial hash).

ops.name: mesh.normals
ops.summary: Vertex normals with crease angle.

ops.name: mesh.subdivide
ops.summary: Linear, Loop or Catmull-Clark subdivision with creases.

ops.name: mesh.decimate
ops.summary: Quadric-error decimation to target count or error.

ops.name: mesh.remesh
ops.summary: Isotropic remesh to edge length.

ops.name: mesh.smooth
ops.summary: Laplacian/Taubin smoothing.

ops.name: mesh.mesh_boolean
ops.summary: Robust mesh boolean (winding-number based).

ops.name: mesh.repair
ops.summary: Fill holes, fix flipped/non-manifold elements.

ops.name: assembly.component
ops.summary: Insert a component (part or product instance) with a position.

ops.name: assembly.coincidence
ops.summary: Coincidence constraint (axes, planes, points).

ops.name: assembly.contact
ops.summary: Contact constraint (planar, line, point contact).

ops.name: assembly.offset
ops.summary: Offset constraint.

ops.name: assembly.angle
ops.summary: Angle constraint (incl. parallel, perpendicular).

ops.name: assembly.fix
ops.summary: Fix component in space.

ops.name: assembly.mechanism_joint
ops.summary: Kinematic joint (revolute, prismatic, cylindrical, gear, rack, cam).

ops.name: assembly.update
ops.summary: Batched assembly constraint solve; reports DOF and conflicts.

ops.name: assembly.exploded_view
ops.summary: Exploded view scenes (presentation only).
